steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A free press is essential for democracy: it holds power to account (investigative journalism exposed the MPs' expenses scandal), informs citizens (enabling informed voting), and provides a platform for debate. Freedom of the press is protected under Article 10 of the ECHR (freedom of expression). | Key Fact: Media regulation: Ofcom regulates broadcasting (TV, radio) - can impose fines and revoke licences. IPSO (Independent Press Standards Organisation) regulates newspapers - handles complaints but cannot impose fines. Some argue regulation should be stronger (Leveson Inquiry after phone-hacking scandal recommended statutory regulation of the press, but this was not fully implemented). | Key Fact: Media bias: all media has some bias - editorial choices about what to cover and how
